player_grid.gml: var c = global.run.car; return (c.gw == 3 && c.gh == 3 && car_cell_count(c) == 9);

player_fits.gml: var c = global.run.car; var used = 0; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(c.facs); i++) used += array_length(c.facs[i].cells); return (used == 5 && array_length(c.facs) == 4);

plate_hole.gml: var c = global.run.car; var s = car_find_space(c, fac("plt_1").cells); if (!is_array(s)) return false; car_place(c, "plt_1", s[0], s[1], 0); return (car_cell_count(c) == 9 && s != -1);

armour_four_conjoined.gml: var ids = ["plt_1", "plt_2", "plt_3"]; for (var n = 0; n < 3; n++) { var cells = fac(ids[n]).cells; if (array_length(cells) != 4) return false; var seen = [true, false, false, false]; var changed = true; while (changed) { changed = false; for (var a = 0; a < 4; a++) { if (!seen[a]) continue; for (var b = 0; b < 4; b++) { if (seen[b]) continue; var dx = abs(cells[a][0] - cells[b][0]); var dy = abs(cells[a][1] - cells[b][1]); if (dx + dy == 1) { seen[b] = true; changed = true; } } } } for (var a = 0; a < 4; a++) if (!seen[a]) return false; } return true;

bandit_fleet.gml: var e = global.cb.enemies; if (array_length(e) != 4) return false; for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) { if (e[i].gw != 2 || e[i].gh != 2) return false; if (array_length(e[i].facs) < 2) return false; } return true;

robot_fleet.gml: var e = global.cb.enemies; if (array_length(e) != 4) return false; if (e[0].gw != 3 || e[0].gh != 3) return false; for (var i = 1; i < 4; i++) { if (e[i].gw != 1 || e[i].gh != 1) return false; } return true;

drones_armed.gml: var e = global.cb.enemies; for (var i = 1; i < array_length(e); i++) { var d = e[i]; if (array_length(d.facs) != 1) return false; if (!fac_active(d.facs[0])) return false; if (fac(d.facs[0].def).charge <= 0) return false; } return true;

corp_grid.gml: var e = global.cb.enemies; return (array_length(e) == 1 && e[0].gw == 4 && e[0].gh == 4);

layouts_onscreen.gml: var cb = global.cb; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(cb.enemies); i++) { var e = cb.enemies[i]; var l = cb.layout_e[i]; if (l.px < 700) return false; if (l.px + e.gw * l.cs > 1270) return false; if (l.py < 70) return false; if (l.py + e.gh * l.cs > 560) return false; } return true;

stray_is_adjacent.gml: var c = global.cb.player; var lay = global.cb.layout_p; var f = c.facs[0]; for (var n = 0; n < 150; n++) { var s = combat_stray(-1, 0); if (s == undefined) return -1; var cx = floor((s.px - lay.px) / lay.cs); var cy = floor((s.py - lay.py) / lay.cs); if (!car_cell_exists(c, cx, cy)) return -2; if (car_at(c, cx, cy) == 0) return -3; var adj = false; for (var k = 0; k < array_length(f.cells); k++) { var ax = f.ox + f.cells[k][0]; var ay = f.oy + f.cells[k][1]; if (abs(ax - cx) + abs(ay - cy) == 1) adj = true; } if (!adj) return -4; if (s.fac != car_at(c, cx, cy)) return -5; } return 150;

stray_hits_bare_grid.gml: var c = global.cb.player; while (array_length(c.facs) > 1) car_remove(c, 1); var bare = 0; for (var n = 0; n < 60; n++) { var s = combat_stray(-1, 0); if (s == undefined) return -1; if (s.fac == -1) bare += 1; } return bare;
